description:
Get a Sentry uptime monitor: its URL, interval, thresholds, status, and recent HTTP check results (status code, duration, failures). Request bodies are never returned; sensitive headers are redacted.
Scheduled jobs (cron): find_monitors. Metric thresholds: find_metric_monitors.
Related issues: search_issues with uptime_rule:<id>.

end.description: Absolute end time. Requires start; not with period.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

period.description: Relative time range for recent checks, such as 24h or 7d. Defaults to 24h without start and end.

projectSlug.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

start.description: Absolute start time. Requires end; not with period.

name: get_uptime_monitor_details

assertion.description: Response assertion tree as configured in Sentry, or null when none is set.

hasRequestBody.description: Whether a request body is configured. The body is never returned.

headers.description: Configured request headers; sensitive values are redacted.

title: Get Uptime Monitor Details
